BEGIN READ ONLY;
SELECT json_build_object(
  'feature_observations', (
    SELECT json_object_agg(feature, observations)
    FROM (SELECT feature, count(*) AS observations
          FROM research.intelligence_observations GROUP BY feature) AS counts),
  'retained_tax_rows', (
    SELECT count(*) FROM research.intelligence_observations WHERE feature = 'TAX'),
  'erased_observation_rows', (
    SELECT count(*) FROM research.intelligence_observations WHERE document IS NULL),
  'permanently_retired_registry_hashes', (
    SELECT count(*) FROM research.intelligence_registry_retirements),
  'select_privileges', (
    SELECT json_object_agg(role_name,
      has_table_privilege(role_name, 'research.intelligence_observations', 'SELECT'))
    FROM (VALUES ('trady_analyst'), ('trady_executor'), ('trady_gateway'),
                 ('trady_shadow'), ('trady_lab'), ('trady_verifier')) AS roles(role_name)),
  'application_base_tables', (
    SELECT json_object_agg(table_schema, base_tables)
    FROM (SELECT table_schema, count(*) AS base_tables
          FROM information_schema.tables
          WHERE table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
            AND table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema')
          GROUP BY table_schema) AS counts)
);
ROLLBACK;
